verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor (CPU/NPU silicon), so a training-data opt-out is a service data-policy question that does not fit this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip collects user data or offers any training opt-out control. The on-device AI and AI Hub material concerns running and optimizing models and does not change that.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
